sloka: इह त्वं जातसंवृद्धः साक्षाद्भ्राता पितुर्मम।कथं द्रुह्यसि पुत्रस्य पितृव्यो मम राक्षस ।। ६.८७.११ ।।
transliteration: iha tvaṁ jātasaṁvṛddhaḥ sākṣādbhrātā piturmama।kathaṁ druhyasi putrasya pitṛvyo mama rākṣasa ।। 6.87.11 ।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! You are born here and brought up by my father. You are my father'sbrother also. How can you be hostile to your son?"
